key_insight: An AI-derived focal TIL score captures localized immune infiltration in lung adenocarcinoma and was associated with overall survival among patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
clinical_relevance: Routine H&E pathology images may support prognostic assessment, but this study does not establish that the score predicts immunotherapy benefit or should guide treatment.
method: Detect lymphocytes using a deep learning model trained on immunohistochemistry-derived ground truth.
Segment tumor and adjacent stroma using a model trained on consensus pathologist annotations.
Quantify localized lymphocyte density across tissue tiles rather than relying on a global average.
evidence_signal: Analytical validation achieved lymphocyte concordance CCC=0.90 and segmentation Dice=0.87; in 685 ICI-treated patients, the score was associated with overall survival (HR=0.60, 95% CI 0.48–0.75; P<0.001), with reported prognostic performance exceeding PD-L1.
watch_item: Prospective validation and comparison with patients not receiving ICI are needed before interpreting the score as predictive of treatment benefit.
paper_title: Quantifying Localized Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes by Deep Learning on H&E Images: Analytical Validation and Prognostic Value in Lung Adenocarcinoma
